notes.title: REMEDIUM Act II Update is Live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/efb72778f6fc61cc3a8052045d5b994c87a828c6.jpg[/img]
Happy Holidays, Survivors!

We’re excited to announce a new update for Act II of REMEDIUM! Our team has been hard at work to enhance your gameplay experience and address your feedback. 

Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] We’ve visually improved the Fort and its surrounding areas for a more immersive atmosphere.
[*] Barriers have been added to the Fort and nearby locations to refine navigation.
[*] Fixed map gaps where players could fall and get stuck.
[*] Additional resources are now scattered throughout locations to aid your journey.
[*] The Harpy's lock-picking mechanic in the village fountain has been revamped.
[*] Final cutscene animations for Act II have been polished for a smoother viewing experience.
[*] Notes have been added to enrich the storytelling and lore.
[*] Transitions between locations are now seamless and consistent.
[*] Fire rings have been added to the Statue Boss to make the battle even more thrilling![/list]

Moreover [b]REMEDIUM[/b] is part of the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/esdigital_games/sale/ESDigitalGamesWinterSale]ESDigital Games Winter Sale[/url][/b] on Steam from [b]December 19 to January 2[/b]! Get ready to dive into this intense twin-stick shooter at a special discount!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/esdigital_games/sale/ESDigitalGamesWinterSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/a4f9d1ef8730ad994970480d5523d87424ac24a5.jpg[/img][/url]

Plus, [b]REMEDIUM[/b] is included in the epic [b]Say Hello to Our Hits Bundle[/b], alongside [b]AWAKEN - Astral Blade[/b], [b]Cats on Duty[/b], [b]Unusual Findings[/b], and [b]9 Monkeys of Shaolin[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48524/Say_hello_to_our_Hits_Bundle/

Thank you to everyone who purchased REMEDIUM for your continued support and feedback! Let us know what you think about the game by writing a review here on Steam, posting it in [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1659090/discussions/]the Discussions[/url][/b], or chat with us on [b][url=https://linktr.ee/ESDGames]the official ESDigital social media accounts[/url][/b]. We'll keep working to improve this game and provide you with a better game experience and new content in near future! And happy holidays!

notes.title: Full Act 2 Update for REMEDIUM Out Today!
notes.content:
Fantastic news everyone! We have today released a [b]new content update for REMEDIUM[/b] via Steam Early Access! This thrilling new update completes the highly anticipated [b]Act 2[/b] of the game and packs in a wealth of new content to expand the world of REMEDIUM.  

The new complete Act 2 update introduces two new locations—[b]the Fort and Abbey[/b]—to the previously released Mine location. These locations contain a host of terrifying enemies and boss types for players to discover and engage in frantic twin-stick shooter action. You will also dive deeper into the storyline with the newly added intro cutscene, providing an engaging introduction to the world of REMEDIUM. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659090/REMEDIUM/

The Act 2 content update will also introduce new quality-of-life improvements, many of which were requested by the community already playing the Steam Early Access release. Some of these quality-of-life improvements include an updated and optimized transitioning system to seamlessly travel between game locations, a new upgrade to the save system so players can replay Act 1 or Act 2 (after starting it for the first time) at any time with their progress saved and with any weapons and upgrades already unlocked, additional balancing of battles to ensure a smooth combat experience, numerous UI and UX improvements and bug fixes and the engaging intro cutscene to set the scene of the carnage of Act 2 perfectly!

[previewyoutube=2Tq5Qhs72Yo;full][/previewyoutube]

Following directly on from the devastating boss battle at the end of Act 1, REMEDIUM Act 2 opens a new chapter in the hunt for a cure to the Grey Plague and to your very survival in the world ravaged by hordes of mutants and chimeras. Armed only with their journal, players must navigate the snowy mountain paths and survive the onslaught of warring tribes of mutants spread across three village locations. In each new location, the blood thirsty mutants are protected by a terrifying and unique boss, who must be defeated in order to unveil the path to the cure for the disease and the survival of the remaining humans. 

[h3]REMEDIUM Act 2 features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Act 2 introduces three new locations with unique mutant types and terrifying bosses.
[*] Discover the new Fort and Abbey locations as well as the Mines. 
[*] Continuation of the intriguing storyline of the hero’s deadly journey.  
[*] Players can craft new parts for their weapons (to further customise them and deal different types of damage) with the new reagents found in Act 2.
[*] Updated visuals and player accessibility for an enhanced gameplay experience.
[*] An improved upgrade system where players can now spend resources to become stronger. 
[*] Dash movement and Almalgams use have been split for greater accessibility.
[*] Language support for English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with further enhancements to be added. 
[/list]
Also, we are today launching a special game bundle on Steam. The ‘[b]Alchemic Bundle’[/b] contains two games - [b]REMEDIUM[/b] and [b]BattleJuice Alchemist[/b] and allows you to purchase both games with the [b]25% discount[/b]. That’s not all, as you can also buy the REMEDIUM game separately with [b]20% discount [/b]which will last for two weeks only!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/41846/Alchemic_Bundle/

notes.title: BattleJuice Alchemist Launches on Steam Early Access Today!
notes.content:
Get ready to delve deeper into the mysterious world of Caribou Creek as the award-winning [b]BattleJuice Alchemist[/b], the complex alchemy RPG, [b]launches today via Steam Early Access[/b]! Developed by [b]Alchemical Works[/b], Battlejuice Alchemist redefines the classic aRPG formula with a unique item and skill system offering the choice between isometric combat and JRPG-style one-on-one battles.

[previewyoutube=6yYXmlTaoSA;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re also thrilled to announce that BattleJuice Alchemist has just received the prestigious ‘[b]GDC Best in Play 2024[/b]’ award and will feature as part of the publisher's lineup at this year's show from 20-22 March at the Moscone Center. 

Join our protagonist, Juice, the Alchemist, on a journey through the wilds of New England, battling demonic hordes and uncovering the secrets of the Crossroads. This exciting Early Access launch unveils a host of new features and mechanics for players to conquer. Build your alchemical tower, a bastion of light amidst the encroaching darkness, and harness its power to turn the tide of battle in your favour. Explore new lands around the new story locations and uncover their hidden treasures and dangers. Dynamic day-night cycles will affect enemy behavior, and an array of new items, perks, magic rituals and abilities wait to be discovered.

During the Early Access journey, Alchemical Works will be working with the community to gather feedback to support their ongoing development roadmap and introduce additional content and updates to fully bring the wonderful world of BattleJuice Alchemist to life.

notes.title: Latest Updates for REMEDIUM!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We're thrilled to announce the latest updates to REMEDIUM. Here's what's new:
[list]
[*] [b]Introduction Cutscene[/b]: Dive deeper into the storyline with the newly added intro cutscene, providing players with an engaging introduction to the world of REMEDIUM.
[*] [b]Various Fixes[/b]: We've addressed several issues related to weapons and enemies, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.

[*] [b]UI Enhancements[/b]: Experience a more seamless interface with numerous fixes and improvements to the main menu, settings, and controls.
[*] [b]Progression Bug Fixes[/b]: Say goodbye to barriers hindering your progress outside of combat, as we've fixed this issue.
[*] [b]Level-Specific Bug Fixes[/b]: Explore the Mines level in Act 2 without worry, as we've resolved bugs related to the cart sequence.
[/list]

We're also excited to share that we're continuously working on expanding the content and enhancing the gameplay experience in Act 2. Now is the perfect time to dive into REMEDIUM, as the price remains unchanged, and we're consistently adding new content based on feedback from our dedicated community.

notes.title: REMEDIUM Act 2 - New Content Released Today!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]the first content update of Act 2 for REMEDIUM[/b]!

Today’s content update is the first stage in the full Act 2 release, including a new location, new mutant types, boss and new story content being made available for players to experience. A further two locations, enemy types, bosses and additional story arcs will be released over the coming weeks to complete the full Act 2 launch.

[previewyoutube=bm1crfsWnqM;full][/previewyoutube]

We also pleased to announce that [b]there will be NO price increase for REMEDIUM following today’s content update[/b]. The price will only increase when we are happy with the content and quality of the game in general and Act 2 in particular. For now, the focus is delivering the most polished and content-complete version of the game during its Steam Early Access phase.  

Since the launch of Act 1, we’ve been busy gathering your feedback and introducing many quality-of-life improvements and new features, many of which were requested by players already active on the Steam Early Access release. We will continue to work with the community on today’s update to improve and polish the upcoming content ahead of the full Act 2 release and extend our thanks for the support and feedback on REMEDIUM’s Early Access launch so far and look forward to further collaboration throughout the development journey.

notes.title: BattleJuice Alchemist transmutes into action!
notes.content:
[i]ESDigital Games[/i] and [i]Alchemical Works[/i] are delighted to reveal their action adventure RPG title [b]BattleJuice Alchemist[/b] and its new announcement trailer!

[previewyoutube=_JlygN27g1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

BattleJuice Alchemist is a complex alchemy RPG that adds an equipment-based skill system to the classic aRPG formula. Focus on top-down combat or opt for JRPG-style one-on-one fights. Explore the wilderness, learn ritual magic, and craft potions to fight demonic hordes overrunning the lands.

Juice, the alchemist, is called to Caribou Creek to fight the demons that roam the lands. As your unique version of Juice, you explore the wilderness that once was New England. Fight evil in classic action RPG isometric top-down view and in bullet-time close combat.

Find and craft items with game-changing powers. Master BattleJuice Alchemist’s deck-building mechanics by arranging your compilation of flasks to suit your playstyle. Accentuate your character beyond character customization by using ritual magic as long-term buffs. Meet strange creatures from the Crossroads while the dark plot of BattleJuice Alchemist unravels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38469214/3a29e0c41079d009f23b3a23afabdb7c86aa9d70.jpg[/img]

[h3]UNIQUE ITEMS AND CHARACTER BUILDS[/h3]
[b]Loot and Craft[/b]: As an alchemist you wear no armor and wield no sword, but you rain down fire on your enemies. Find flasks with unique properties in the wilderness or craft them at your workbench. In deck-building fashion you create a compilation of flasks which you randomly draw from.

[b]Unique Skill System[/b]: In BattleJuice Alchemist, your flasks are your skills. Every flask can be used the normal way and at times in a supercharged, "jucified" way for stronger effects. Some flasks have powers attached to them that drastically change their effects when used, which allows you to develop your own playstyle.

[h3]EXPLORE A DARK WORLD[/h3]
[b]Procedural Landscapes, Hand-crafted Towns[/b]: The world of BattleJuice Alchemist is separated into vast levels of procedural landscape. Every valley, sea, river, mountain, building, stone, tree and item is placed by a unique algorithm. This allows you to continue exploring after you completed the main story. Quest locations are still hand-crafted to tell compelling stories.

[b]Dark Lands to Discover[/b]: You are influenced by daytime and weather effects and so are your enemies. But they are also buffed by the evermore spawning demons’ presence. Find dark altars to hold their influence at bay and discover many other secrets.

[h3]ENGAGING COMBAT[/h3]
[b]Classic isometric ARPG action[/b]: Fight your enemies from afar in classic top down view. Throw explosive or freezing flasks at them, prepare ambushes of explosive barrels. Use the “Frog Hop” flask to jump away from danger or right into close combat.

[b]Close Combat with Bullet-time[/b]: Enter close combat with an enemy, where you can interact hands on by dodging or using smoke flasks to avoid being hit. Manage your resources and flasks during these intense one on one battles against your awe-inspiring enemies from the Crossroads.

notes.title: REMEDIUM Combats Fate in Compelling First Chapter Today!
notes.content:
GREAT NEWS EVERYONE! REMEDIUM, the twin-stick shooter set in the grim post-apocalyptic Renaissance, engages the unforgiving wilds in the first chapter, is now available on Steam Early Access with a 20% launch discount!

[previewyoutube=UkLscFfPDPY;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Set in the same decaying universe as REMEDIUM: Sentinels, REMEDIUM’s second and third installments will enter the fray later this year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/65b6b466b996207857eac35fa131085b20b8daa5.jpg[/img]
 
Decades after the horrific Grey Plague wiped out nearly all human life, turning unfortunate souls and delicate fauna into decaying, hungry beasts, little remains. The few remaining survivors desperately fortify their defenses while searching for a cure, but hope dwindles for one as when a mission outside the fortress walls results in the infection invading their veins. He must scour the devastated landscape in search of a cure or be cast from the encampment forever.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/36751a6461db4323589f5a06cc1f54634ec7ed9f.jpg[/img]

Slay abominable mutants in perishing biomes, ready to strike in deadly droves. Evade chimeras, gargoyles, golems, elementals, and more with skillful dodging maneuvers while tearing through them with powerful combinations of firearms and alchemical ammunition. As the infection grows stronger, make the most of its horrific symptoms by using them as battle advantages.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/6d876e95df2afdd993bb2e8f5abcbdd31d7331d7.jpg[/img]

Search every dark corner for vital ingredients to upgrade weapons, armor, strength, and stamina in the form of amalgams, injections, and potions. Inoculate as needed to enhance combat abilities, or weave mysterious elemental power into dwindling ammunition to make every shot count. Fight through every last beast and boss to survive long enough to find the antidote!

notes.title: REMEDIUM: Sentinels Unleashed Today! Embark on an Epic Adventure Now!
notes.content:
[b]Today is THE DAY, fellow Sentinels![/b]
 
REMEDIUM: Sentinels has officially released, and we couldn't be more excited. Get ready to immerse yourself in an extraordinary experience filled with new features and improvements that have been implemented since the game's Early Access phase.
 
Prepare for an expanded world of possibilities as we introduce a range of exciting updates. We now boast an impressive roster of 8 playable Sentinels, each with their unique abilities and playstyles. Traverse meticulously crafted locations, soaking in the atmospheric environments that will captivate your senses. Arm yourself with a diverse arsenal of weapons and upgrades to take on the hordes of adversaries that await. These additions were not available during the initial release, making the game even more engaging and dynamic.
 
But that's not all! We have gone above and beyond to enhance the player experience. Significant improvements have been made to the HUD and interface, ensuring smooth navigation and seamless interaction. Prepare to showcase your skills and compete with players globally through the introduction of world leaderboards. We are committed to making the leaderboards even more engaging and exciting for you! Additionally, we have expanded the list of achievements, satisfying the insatiable quest for glory of achievement hunters. And rest assured, we have plans to continue adding new achievements in the future.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43428411/6768507d643c281c954e683ff69b5cad06ecedaa.jpg[/img]

To further enhance gameplay, we have implemented quality of life improvements. Discover new interactive objects that grant additional scores when standing nearby, providing strategic advantages in the heat of battle. For example, in the "Mines" level, now you have to push the minecart to earn points. To make it happen, the Sentinel needs to be next to it while fending off hordes of enemies (they haven't gone anywhere)! Furthermore, we have introduced additional elemental versions of weapons, each with its unique effects, bringing more diversity and dynamism to combat encounters.
 
Today's release of REMEDIUM: Sentinels marks an exciting milestone in our journey. We are determined to deliver an exceptional gaming experience, and we can't wait for you to join us. Embark on an unforgettable adventure of survival and discovery, and let the world of REMEDIUM: Sentinels captivate you.
 
Get ready to push your limits, showcase your skills, and become a true Sentinel. Today is the day we've been waiting for!
 
[b]Stay strong and PUSH THE PLAY BUTTON![/b]

Set in the universe of REMEDIUM’s post-apocalyptic Renaissance, more than one hundred years have passed since the initial onslaught of the calamitous Grey Plague, which decimated a once-flourishing continent. Among the few remaining humans, brave scientists funneled their resources into constructing mankind’s last hope, the Sentinels - gargantuan metallic golems born of technological advancement and mysterious alchemy. 

As one of the few remaining Sentinels, rise as humanity’s last line of defense, taking on endless hordes of infected mutants until the reactor runs out of power. Wield an expanded arsenal of automatic, alchemy-based weapons and unleash devastating attacks upon swarms of plague-ridden beasts and bosses. Clear maps while collecting glowing Prime Matter and resources to upgrade guns, projectiles, and defenses. 

Find a fitting balance of weapon and force fields for all 8 Sentinels to prepare for the monstrosities that lie ahead. Match the machines with optimal offensive and defensive armaments and elemental upgrades to reach each Sentinel’s fullest potential and improve survival time with every run.

notes.title: REMEDIUM to Participate in Future Games Show 2023 + Open Beta Test!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that REMEDIUM will be participating in the highly anticipated Future Games Show 2023, taking place from June 10th to June 12th! This is an incredible opportunity for us to showcase the game to a global audience of gaming enthusiasts.
 
To celebrate this exciting event, we are offering an open beta test of REMEDIUM for all those who are eager to experience the game before its official release. We invite you to join us and be among the first to explore the captivating world of REMEDIUM and provide valuable feedback to help us further enhance the gameplay.
 
Don't miss this incredible opportunity to be a part of the REMEDIUM experience, mark your calendars for the Future Games Show 2023 and get ready to embark on an unforgettable gaming journey!

notes.title: NEW GAME - REMEDIUM: Sentinels
notes.content:
[h3][b]New roguelite fast-paced auto-shooter REMEDIUM: Sentinels is now available in Early Access![/b][/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2244480/REMEDIUM_Sentinels/
The game is set in the same world as [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1659090/REMEDIUM/]REMEDIUM[/url][/b] game. It has been more than a hundred years since the Grey Plague has won turning most humans into vicious mutant freaks, and only a handful of cities still stand amidst the death and chaos that consumed the land.
 
Now you can take control of a Sentinel created by alchemists with only one goal - defend the cities against the endless hordes of mutants until your reactor dies. Combine items and alchemical elements to acquire more and more weapons and create unique builds. 
 
[h3]Easy to play, hard to master![/h3]
 
[previewyoutube=m8xQS2oK8Cc;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Share your ideas how to improve the game on developers official [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/nJkZ4rkn5Q]Discord server[/url][/b].

notes.title: Scholar of the Arcane Arts
notes.content:
New Roguelike Action RPG Scholar of the Arcane Arts is already available in early access!
 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1650200/Scholar_of_the_Arcane_Arts/
 
Learn new spells, solve puzzles, unlock secret dungeons, and defeat monstrous beings to save the world invaded by five Planes of magic! Every spell you cast interacts with one another. About a hundred spells and 10,000 combinations await you! All worlds are randomly generated, so each playthrough will be unique.
 
Try your hand at the art of magic and take part in the development of the game! Talk to the developer and other players on [url=https://discord.com/invite/UXfcwWFewy]Discord[/url] to reach unprecedented heights of mastery in Scholar of the Arcane Arts!

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
Good news everyone! We have improved and expanded REMEDIUM free demo!

More levels are now available and the average duration of the demo has tripled! It is also possibile to craft new weapons at the workbench, which gives even more depth to exploration and battles. And finally, in addition to fixing stability and dealing with some bugs, the visual side was also improved: the interface, the special effects of shots and explosions, the appearance of locations and the in-game diary were all updated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/7b11a65337941cae1bf107d9b718b5a00fc1e7ab.jpg[/img]
[i]Shooting is more satisfying with new effects, right?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/6099ad15ee6a4d4205433bbd78f90f8700fc2e9e.jpg[/img]
[i]New HUD is more colorful and detailed[/i]


Enjoy the demo and stay tuned!

notes.title: Game and demo update
notes.content:
Dear players!

Thank you for playing the [b]Remedium[/b] demo. We continue to read your feedback and work on various improvements. Today we decided to share with you what we have already managed to change and update in the game:

💡 Made the whole environment lighter and richer in colors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/c93aba59561cb983885cdc5d319c4068ad5e7360.jpg[/img]
[i]Worked on the lights, now you can see where you're going.[/i]

👁 Removed the obscuring elements on the rooftops.
👁 Added readability to enemies by highlighting some elements.
👁 Changed the model of the protagonist, for more anatomy, taking into account the game camera.

📚 Added health and armor tutorial.

⚙️ Fixed alchemy ammo - now it falls from the minibosses, and switches by middle mouse button.
⚙️ Fixed restart - now after the death the player does not throw out to the main menu.
⚙️ Fixed the sound settings options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/a4efa38dd04e576146b41a1386bbe63bc507200c.jpg[/img]
[i]Bred a new more dangerous monsters[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/f7da29a06020f53a8885c34ae85edd3b2144354e.jpg[/img]
[i]Added warmth to the city's streets[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/5d8d794223771a782f749e3005961b83954f788f.jpg[/img]
[i]Made Hell's Deep more hell and deeper[/i]

[b]Don't forget to add the game to Wishlist on Steam![/b]

notes.title: With the weekend coming up, it's time to play!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, friends! [/h2]

The festival continues, as does the active development of the game. This means that your opinion about REMEDIUM is critically important for us! Demo will be available until June 20, so try it while there's still time =) 

On Saturday we have a new broadcast scheduled, where we will show a little more content than what is available in the demo. A couple of locations, enemies and interesting "features". We suggest you check it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/47a042cab792d30d0ac2d6638b37cd78a000a19a.jpg[/img]

[h2]And remember: added the game to your wishlist - increased chance of finding the Philosopher's Stone (don't know why you need it, but someone say it's useful). [/h2]

notes.title: The plague is coming, are you ready?
notes.content:
Have you tried the demo of our new game yet? If not, do it! There's not much time left until the end of Steam Nest Fest, so don't waste it. And if you don't have it, we'd love to help you out. 

On Thursday, June 16, at 10.00 a.m. pacific we will launch the broadcast on the main REMEDIUM game page and show you the gameplay. So you can keep busy with your work or study and watch us in the background! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/3c8dbee8530ad95c3ab61910863e4fb4b8b7d146.jpg[/img]

[h2]And don't forget: adding a game to your wishlist reduces your chances of mutating into a plague monster (although it's not certain, but it's better to reassure yourself). [/h2]

notes.title: WATCH, PLAY, ADD TO THE WISHLIST!
notes.content:
Hey, what's that coming? A plague cloud?! No! It's the [b]STEAM NEXT FEST[/b]!

[h2]And that means that you'll finally get to try our new game - REMEDIUM.[/h2] Because for one week you'll be able to [b]play a free demo[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082513/1e6cca8e0da553fb70f72ca1e323f37d41306f2c.jpg[/img]

And we'll also be sure to show you the gameplay, so even if you can't play yourself, you definitely can check out the gameplay. Come to the game page on June 13 at 8 a.m. pacific.

[h3]And for those who add REMEDIUM to wishlist, we would like to say especially "thank you very much".[/h3]

By doing so, not only will you not miss out on all the fun stuff, but you'll also help the game develop. So yes, thank you!
